destinations.name: Nepal
destinations.tagline: Eight of the world's ten highest peaks, and the villages beneath them
destinations.intro: From the Khumbu glaciers to the grasslands of the Terai, Nepal packs more change of scenery into a week than most countries manage in a lifetime. Trek to a base camp, walk the old trade routes of Mustang, or track rhinos on the jungle floor.

trips.title: Everest Base Camp Trek
trips.summary: The classic walk through Sherpa country to the foot of the world's highest mountain, with sunrise over Everest from Kala Patthar.
highlights: Sunrise view of Everest from Kala Patthar (5,545 m)
Tengboche Monastery and its prayer hall

itinerary.title: Dingboche
